en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of early‑20th‑century soldiers in dark uniforms and peaked caps standing in formation outdoors on a sandy training ground bordered by trees and grassy embankments. On the left, an officer sits at a small wooden booth or desk while another soldier stands beside him holding a notebook. At the center, an officer appears to be inspecting or adjusting the equipment of a soldier wearing a backpack and rifle; another soldier stands at a small folding table with papers. In the background is a low earthen berm or shooting range wall. The scene looks like a formal military inspection or training exercise. No printed caption or text is visible on the image itself.
